notes: Validated against Warner et al. Nat Chem Biol 2017 (doi:10.1038/nchembio.2439) and Sjekloca & Pabit 2019. 5BJP: Corn homodimer with DFHO (747 ligand). CRITICAL: Corn functions as a HOMODIMER — DFHO is encapsulated at the interprotomer interface, sandwiched between a G-quadruplex from each chain. Chain Y used for MacDock receptor; chain E is the second protomer. DFHO imidazolinone-phenyl system stacks on G-quartets from both protomers. Six unpaired adenosines at the dimer interface break two-fold symmetry. No phosphate in DFHO → only stacking term fires. Single-chain MacDock docking cannot fully capture dimer-interface binding.
